notes: TaxyHook (src/TaxyHook.sol) is an immutable Uniswap v4 hook that charges a 4% fee on every swap of a pool that names it, always in native ETH, and pays it to 0x047F606fD5b2BaA5f5C6c4aB8958E45CB6B054B7 inside the same swap via poolManager.take. Fee = floor(gross ETH / 25) where gross is the buyer's total ETH paid or the AMM's ETH output on a sale. The constructor takes only the IPoolManager (written here as $poolManager; the deployer fills in the launch chain's manager) and validates the deployed address against the hook flags 0x20cc. getHookPermissions returns exactly beforeInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta and afterSwapReturnDelta; all other callbacks are disabled and revert if called. beforeInitialize is enabled so a predicted pool cannot be initialized before the hook has code; it and every other callback accept calls only from the constructor-supplied PoolManager. beforeInitialize rejects any pool whose currency0 is not native ETH, whose currency1 is the zero address, that uses a dynamic LP fee, or that does not name this hook. beforeSwapReturnDelta reserves the fee as a positive specified delta when ETH is the specified amount; afterSwapReturnDelta charges it as an unspecified delta otherwise. The hook never holds ETH or tokens, never swaps itself, and the fee leaves PoolManager during the swap. No one can change it: there is no owner, fee setter, recipient setter, pause, upgrade, withdrawal or exemption. TaxyToken (src/TaxyToken.sol) is an OpenZeppelin ERC-20 named taxy, symbol t4, 18 decimals, no constructor arguments; it mints its whole fixed supply to its deployer and has no mint, owner, proxy or hooks. Pool: native ETH (currency0, zero address) paired with t4 (currency1), static LP fee 3000 (0.3%) and tick spacing 60, the configuration the README names and the test suite exercises. initialPrice is sqrtPriceX96 for 100,000,000 t4 per ETH: sqrt(1e8) * 2^96 = 10000 * 79228162514264337593543950336. The hook does not read or constrain the price; this is the starting price for the launch pool and any other price would work identically. Local tests use the 1:1 price. Hook address must be mined for the low 14 bits 0x20cc against the actual CREATE2 caller; script/MineTaxySalt.s.sol provides an offline search. The fee is paid before the trader's ETH input settles, so PoolManager must already hold enough native ETH for the transfer or the swap reverts; ETH-specified swaps must fully fill. Supply, allocations, chain and ownership policy are not manifest fields.
